map.由综合成本率反推承保利润 使用指南: Underwriting Profit from Combined Ratio — User Guide
map.承保利润率计算器。输入赔付率与费用率，按 承保利润率 = 1 − (赔付率+费用: Underwriting profit margin calculator. Enter the loss ratio and expense ratio to back out underwriting profit as 1 − (loss ratio + expense ratio), for property-casualty profitability assessment.
map.输入赔付率与费用率，求承保利润率。: Enter the loss ratio and expense ratio to get the underwriting profit margin.
map.已知综合成本率 CR，承保利润 = 保费×(1−CR)。: Given combined ratio CR, underwriting profit = premium×(1−CR).
map.看承保端贡献的利润空间。: See the profit margin contributed by underwriting.
map.：承保利润 = 100万×(1−0.95) = 5 万。即承保端赚 5 万，利润: : underwriting profit = 1,000,000×(1−0.95) = 50,000 CNY, i.e. underwriting earns 50,000 CNY, a 5% margin.
map.由年给付与年金因子求净单保费: Net Single Premium from Annual Annuity and Annuity Factor
map.CR 95% 承保利润 5% 对吗？: Is a 95% CR a 5% underwriting profit correct?
map.对。综合成本率=赔付率+费用率，1−CR 即承保利润率；投资收益另算。: Correct. Combined ratio = loss ratio + expense ratio, so 1−CR is the underwriting margin; investment income is counted separately.
map.承保利润率和综合成本率永远互补吗？: Are the underwriting margin and combined ratio always complementary?
map.是，承保利润率等于100% 减综合成本率（不含投资）。但公司总利润还含投资收益，: Yes, the underwriting margin equals 100% minus the combined ratio (excluding investment). But total company profit also includes investment income, so a low CR isn't necessarily good performance—if investments suffer large losses, a slim underwriting profit cannot save it.
